purpose: Apply the frozen v0.91 synthesized recursive state-dominance rule, without retraining, to a fresh external travelling-salesman family already represented by a strong native Held-Karp dynamic program.

source.selection_rule: Three catalogue-listed TSPLIB XML archives whose raw graph contents were not opened during v0.91 synthesis or the v0.92 preregistration research.

projection.rule: After archive hash lock and re-verification, parse the TSPLIB XML graph and retain vertices with relative XML identifiers 0 through 8 inclusive. Retain the exact directed edge cost between every ordered pair of those nine vertices. Ignore all remaining vertices.
projection.reason: Nine cities keep an independent full-tour enumeration certificate feasible while still exercising a complete Held-Karp state space.

two_stage_access_protocol.stage_1: Download and hash the three archive byte streams only. Do not unzip, parse XML, inspect edge costs, construct TSP states, or compute reductions.
two_stage_access_protocol.stage_2: May run only after the exact stage-1 manifest is committed. Re-download and verify final URL, byte count and SHA-256 before unzipping/parsing.

native_baseline.algorithm: Held-Karp subset dynamic programming with state (visited_mask,last_vertex), start fixed to vertex 0, and exact return-to-start terminal action.
native_baseline.independent_certificate: Enumerate all 8! tours over vertices 1..8 and require the minimum tour cost to equal the Held-Karp optimum.
native_baseline.cost_requirement: All selected projected edge costs must be finite, nonnegative and integral after parsing the official XML costs.

candidate.algorithm: The exact same Held-Karp state graph with only the frozen v0.91 synthesized state relation used for local action elimination.
forbidden: changing the nine-city projection after raw access
retraining or reselecting the v0.91 grammar rule

kill_rule: If any exact objective certificate disagrees, or fewer than two projected TSPLIB instances have positive expansion reduction, or aggregate reduction is below 5%, preserve v0.92 as rejected. Do not retrain v0.91, change the selected archives, change the nine-city projection, or add TSP-specific pruning to repair v0.92.
interpretation_if_pass: Strong external transfer evidence: a rule synthesized without TSP data provides meaningful exact pruning on top of a native Held-Karp representation and independently certified tour optima. It remains a systems/discovery result, not a new simulation theorem or TSP state of the art.
interpretation_if_fail: The v0.91 synthesized simulation relation does not transfer meaningfully to a canonical external TSP dynamic program. Preserve the boundary and move toward richer generic reduction synthesis rather than fitting TSP.
